findings: Design review retained a shorter trusted deadline as negative evidence on an exact existing pre-proof cleanup even if verification ages while waiting. Positive registration still requires age strictly below 30000 ms; stale work cannot create a row or return permission. Safe time, nonfuture verification and exact current association precede shortening.

Source review corrected an ambiguous local claim-id/thread-id reference by qualifying the thread column before behavioral execution, and avoided same-value cleanup updates on exact replay. These corrections touched only the new SQL draft.

The first completed SQL run passed 54 of 56 cases. One fixture tried to set deleted_at directly while retaining saved content, violating the existing P3b constraint; it now uses the actual P3b delete fence. Another expected legacy inspect to return replayed, while the existing contract returns claimed. Correcting only those fixture assumptions produced 56/56. Initial diagnostics are preserved; no existing constraint, assertion intent or implementation behavior was weakened.

Additional direct constraint and preexisting-legacy-row checks verify the promised additive-schema provenance, alongside private helper privilege denial. Primary transport tests passed 44/44 on their first run; two independent real-adapter composition cases deny v2 observations in the unchanged v1 admission chain before proof/claim/inspect and retain exact cleanup for close. Root and independent source review found no remaining blocker. Final focused/full tests, strict types/scoped lint and production build pass on frozen files; live Auth/native/provider evidence remains separate.
